messages.subject: Is there a package for connecting to gmail API?

Hi guys,

I'm 3 months new to shiny and have written my first app which is an adaptation of a shiny dashboard.

Next on my to do list is to attempt to connect to the gmail API and get a list of messages to populate a dynamic drop down menu list.

Cheers

Sam
